name: The Camellia Hotel
line: Warmth That Starts On The Roof
lede: Through a cold Sydney winter, The Camellia Hotel wanted heat that stays discreet, adjusts to the evening and recesses neatly into the ceiling. The owner is reported to run the Bromic heaters on the pub’s rooftop solar.

hero.caption: Comparable Bromic installation, not this project: replace with project photography once licensed.

beats: A local pub in Rosehill, in Sydney’s west, with newly built outdoor areas.
The brief was heat that stays discreet, adjusts to the evening, recesses neatly into the ceiling and sits in harmony with the decor.
The pub chose Bromic heaters, and the owner is reported to run them on the venue’s rooftop solar, so the warmth overhead begins with the sun on the roof.
